excerpt.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
excerpt.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

texts.zh: 我们的特工已经确保了我们在[root.target.GetName]受邀出席的在一次星际科学会议上的方便。我们的工作重点仅是侦察[root.target.GetAdj]代表团。
texts.en: Our operatives have secured attendance at an interstellar, scientific conference to which the [root.target.GetName] have also been invited. Our efforts are focused on scouting only the [root.target.GetAdj] delegation.

texts.zh: 我们潜伏的特工们已经完全渗透了[root.target.GetAdj]国内举办的一次尖端云集的会议上。他们已经开始寻找那些潜在目标。
texts.en: Our undercover operatives are dispersed throughout a promising-looking conference being held in [root.target.GetAdj] space. They have begun scouting potential targets.

texts.zh: 我们已经安排了一些特工在[root.target.GetName]上举办的讲座中充当观众。他们将会在这些知识精英中寻找潜在的领袖。
texts.en: We have placed operatives in the audience at a number of lectures being held in the [root.target.GetName]. We will watch for potential leads amongst their intellectual elite.

texts.zh: 我们的特工分散在[root.target.GetName]为造福他们自己的公民而运行的各种科学宣传计划中。我们的行动目的就是想对这些计划有所了解。
texts.en: Our operatives have dispersed amongst the various scientific outreach schemes being run by the [root.target.GetName] for the benefit of their own citizenry. Our target for this endeavor may very well just make themselves known to us.

texts.zh: 我们的特工已经开始监视[root.target.GetAdj]上的一座研究设施。我们会利用一切存在的切入点。
texts.en: Our operatives have begun surveilling a [root.target.GetAdj] research facility. Wherever an entry point exists, we shall exploit it.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑[spynetwork.leader.GetName]报告称，我们特工的行动遇到了不可逾越的障碍：[target.GetAdj]的工程技术突飞猛进，远远甩开了我们。

任何可能从他们那里窃取的技术都已变得浑不可解——且与我们现有的技术体系不兼容。
texts.en:
Spymaster [spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports that our operatives have met an insurmountable obstacle: [target.GetAdj] engineering appears to have advanced and deviated far from our own.

Any technology we might hope to steal from them would be inscrutable to us - as well as incompatible with what we currently possess.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]提交了一份报告，事关[from.target.GetName]境内的[from.GetName]行动。似乎看上去[from.target.GetAdj]的科学和工程学已经先进到了可以欺瞒我方最专业的特工的地步了。他们宣称其内部技术和我们自己的科技截然不同，即使我们设法偷到了一两项科技，仿制出来的硬件也无法和我们自己的兼容

间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]建议我们去其他的地方再窃取类似的秘密。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] has submitted a report on Operation [from.GetName], inside the [from.target.GetName]. It seems that [from.target.GetAdj] science and engineering have advanced to the point of bamboozling our expert operatives. They claim that the underlying technology has deviated greatly from our own, meaning that even if we could somehow steal their research, the resulting hardware would be incompatible with ours.

Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] suggests that we appropriate such secrets elsewhere.
